execution_contract.account: One global slot, 0.5% planned-loss risk, 3x notional cap and 0.1% of the completed signal minute's USD-M quote volume.
execution_contract.entry: Next exact contiguous USD-M one-minute open after a completed signal bar.
execution_contract.exit: Fixed hold or adverse stop-first, with gap stops executed at the observed open and an extra two adverse basis points on stopped paths.
execution_contract.funding: Official calc_time retained for inclusion in (entry, exit]; official containing-minute mark open, with exact same-minute USD-M contract-open fallback only when that mark observation is absent.
execution_contract.missing_data: Regular UTC minute grid with absences retained as NaN; no filling, interpolation, synthetic OHLC or timeline compression.

known_weaknesses: Only 17 trades were generated, far below the 150-trade development requirement.
The median account return is negative at 12, 18 and 24 basis points.
The top five positive trades contribute 92.7567% of positive PnL at 12 basis points.
Removing the largest 10% of trades changes the 12-basis-point return to -0.5817%.
ETH contributes +5.1768% while BTC contributes -0.7024%; the largest two ETH longs determine the sign of total return.
Minute bars cannot establish sub-minute price discovery or queue position.
Historical spread and partial fills are represented by stressed all-in cost profiles rather than historical bid/ask reconstruction.
Comparison with existing ranked results is provisional because windows, markets and execution contracts differ.
summary: Hard-valid official Binance BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT spot-versus-USD-M one-minute price-discovery study. All 496 preregistered policies failed the 2022 development gate, so 2023 and later remained unopened. The best perpetual-overshoot-reversal candidate produced 17 trades, +4.4380% total return and 0.0118976% geometric daily growth at 12bp, PF 2.464 and MDD 1.234%, but had a negative median trade, 92.76% top-five positive-PnL concentration and -0.5817% after removing the top 10% of trades. The current first place remains unchanged; this result is provisional rank 3 by target proximity only.
